name: Abyssal Garden · the reef

frame.span: reef radius 78 m, water surface at SY = 26 m
frame.origin: where you dive: the reef's offset from its dive site is added to where you went under

bands.scent: when you start swimming (the reef loads hidden)
bands.pour: Dive (the live act over deep water)
bands.drain: Surface, or swim up to the top

carries: its own WebGL2 renderer, untouched: sun shadows, volumetric light shafts, caustics, kelp (45k to 220k blades by detail), coral, sponges, rocks, pebbles
its life: fish schools, mantas, jellies, a whale; the wreck, the coral arch, the trench
its six dive sites (chance by place picks one, so the same water gives the same reef)
its own swim physics and collision; its sound
controls: the trough's surface: the stick swims (sideways turns), dragging looks and pitches, Jump lifts you, the exit drop surfaces you
note: layer@1: a can that cannot share the trough's renderer is poured as a layer with its own canvas. The trough stops drawing, hands its controls and the rain glass to the layer, and takes the pose back when you surface.
